The further attached images (in order, <EXTRA SHEETS>) are companion sheets of the same character, referred to in the prompt. Save the generated PNG unmodified as <TARGET> (create the directory if needed). Do not modify any other file. Reply with the saved path and its pixel size. Image prompt: <PROMPT>
motion_sheets.invocation: codex exec -s workspace-write -C . -c 'model_reasoning_effort="medium"' -i public/world/ants.png -i <each extra sheet> -o <scratch>/codex-<name>-<n>.txt -- "<WRAPPER>" </dev/null
motion_sheets.notes: ants-lookup-back.png: columns straight back half tilt (atlas pose tilt), straight back full tilt, back-right, back-left (columns 3 and 4 came out swapped against the prompt); rows neutral, fear, hope, bright neutral, bright hope. It replaces ants-lookup.png in the atlas (that sheet is no longer composed); the hope and bright-hope back-left cells are left out and the back-right ones are mirrored at run time. ants-pass.png: row 1 hope passing step in f, l, r, b; rows 2-5 in fl, bl, br, fr: neutral passing step, hope walk A, hope walk B, hope passing step. ants-phone-bright.png: columns f, l, r, b; rows bright neutral on the phone, bright neutral relieved (composed as neutral-bright.sigh), bright hope on the phone, bright hope relieved, then the unchanged dull ant on the phone (tone reference only, not a frame); the bright hope phone back cell is mirrored when composing so the scarf tail stays on one side.
